_readme: Every ONE-OFF item in the game — today that is the two potions and nothing else. Two sister files generate the rest and both are preferred to authoring by hand here: itemsets.json expands an armour material into one item per plus level, and weapons.json expands a weapon family into one item per tier (a Sturdy sword that rewards Strength and a Nimble one that rewards Dexterity, from the same authored steel). Weapons in particular belong there rather than here, because a weapon authored here carries no scaling grades and is therefore strictly worse than a generated one at the same Attack — see each file's own _readme. THE STARTING KIT IS GONE (AUDIT #114): six startingStock Equipment rows — gloves_of_strength, iron_helm, amulet_of_wisdom, leather_cuirass, padded_greaves, swift_boots — used to live here, and because the reward roll draws from Equippables rather than from ContentDatabase.Offerable, all six turned up as floor-1 rewards for gear the player already owned. The owner's call was to delete them rather than to narrow the roll around them, so a new profile now starts with an empty stash. The startingStock field itself still resolves and still means what docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md says; no row authors it today. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. Mixing field sets — a Weapon with an amount, a Consumable with an attackBonus, Equipment using attackBonus instead of statBonus.attack — is rejected rather than silently ignored. A Weapon1 item also fits Weapon2, so dual-wielding needs no second entry. Weapon drops are tiered automatically by attackBonus: see FightController.RollWeaponDrop — Elite rooms drop from the weaker half of the list, Boss rooms from the stronger half, so no dropTier field is needed here. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.
